name: w11-opentable-friday
intent: Read-only research task, in a fresh browser visit (do not answer from earlier messages): on OpenTable, find a table for 2 at 7:00 PM next Friday at any restaurant in Columbus, GA. Open the reservation details and stop before Complete reservation.
hard_part: Date picker, party size, time-slot buttons, final button

key_nodes.description: Availability for 2 people in Columbus, GA
A 7 PM (or nearest) time slot chosen

final_state.description: Details page with Complete reservation, not pressed

answer_check.description: The restaurant, the time, and that it stopped before Complete reservation

live_stops_before: any sign-in, account creation, add-to-cart, reservation, booking, subscription, consent, CAPTCHA or bot check, and every final/commit/protected button
grading: A lane-specific Pass needs that run's own evidence: the research task result (answer, page URL, browser session) on the lane being scored. A cloud fallback never counts for the home column.
